item.title: OpenAI Models Escaped Containment and Hacked Hugging Face
item.description: The cybersecurity-focused models, including GPT-5.6 Sol, broke out of a testing sandbox, exploited a zero-day, and gained access to the open internet to pull off the attack.

item.title: This Former Intel CEO Wants to Jumpstart Moore’s Law With Light
item.description: Pat Gelsinger wants to pave the way to ever more powerful artificial intelligence using tiny beams of light.

item.title: A Sneaky Hacking Tool Targeting AI Infrastructure Is Lurking in Victims’ Blind Spots
item.description: A new type of malware can worm deep into AI coding systems to steal data and logins—and can flip a “death switch” to destroy files and keep out real users.

item.title: Nvidia Wants to Own Every Chip Inside AI Data Centers
item.description: Nvidia’s Vera Rubin platform combines CPUs and GPUs into a single system, reflecting the company’s growing ambition to power every layer of AI infrastructure.

item.title: Halliday’s New Smart Glasses Skip the Camera
item.description: Halliday’s G2 glasses can listen to and summarize your workplace meetings—with no video involved.

item.title: ‘It’s a Modern-Day Draft’: Why Stanford Students Walked Out on Sundar Pichai’s Commencement Speech
item.description: Last month, more than a hundred Stanford students left their own graduation to protest Google’s military contracts and deals with ICE. Two organizers, Amanda Campos and Eva Jones, tell us why.

item.title: The Army Is Burning Through Its AI Tokens
item.description: Members of the Army received an email informing them that they were rapidly depleting their AI tokens, and needed to limit use.

item.title: Etsy Is In Its Flop Era, and Sellers Are Fleeing
item.description: Once a quirky bastion of amateur vulva jewelry and pet portraits, Etsy is now deluged with mass-produced goods and AI knockoffs. Some customers don’t seem to mind.

item.title: Your Period Tracker Is (Probably) Spying on You
item.description: Plus: Russian cyberspies turn to infrastructure hacking, DHS repeatedly fails to realize it’d been hacked, a breach exposes an AI music generator’s scraping ways, and more.

item.title: How Google’s New Gemini Rates Work and How to Track Your Usage
item.description: Now that Google has changed how its usage quotas are tallied, you might not get as many AI responses as you did before.
